description.value: Beyond Bread is a well-regarded artisan bakery and cafe in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, producing hand-shaped sourdough loaves and French-style pastries using certified organic whole grains from Canadian family farms. The bakery has attracted loyal fans for standout items like its baguette, croissants, and pain au chocolat, and also carries coffee, brewing gear, and grocery items. It sits on West 4th Avenue, a busy cycling corridor through Kitsilano, making it a natural refuelling stop for cyclists passing through.
